title_en: Jurisprudence of Women (233): The Necessity of Distinguishing Between the Prophetic Biography and the Prophetic Sunna (4)
summary: In this lesson, His Eminence Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari continues his advanced jurisprudence lectures on the jurisprudence of women, focusing on the necessity of distinguishing between the Prophetic biography (sira) and the Prophetic Sunna.
